title: The Last of Us Remastered (tlou-remastered-pc)
description: Native Windows PC port of The Last of Us Remastered (PS4, CUSA00552). Runs the game’s own x86-64 code on a custom runtime, with PS4 system libraries reimplemented and a Vulkan renderer based on shadPS4. Includes a launcher. No game files included: you need your own copy.
